arStrings.szText: ...After the theft of Zerae’s soul, Mount Arnazeus’ burning peaks froze solid. Hefaetrus never returned, believed to be lost inside the spirit world. Though, some believe that the Great Watcher Karcheus is what remains of Hefaetrus.
Formal, an entry in a historical record.
Stealing Zerae’s soul turned Mount Arnazeus’ burning peaks into frigid snow. Who is to say that the same did not happen to Hefaetrus? The man of flame, frozen by the cost of rebirth...
Formal, an entry in a historical record.
